title: Jephthah
description: Ruler of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-14 (Table 5, "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.date: Column: Ruler of Israel; Name row (Year BC): 1152; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1147 (year 6)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, Table 5 "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)", p. 54
reign.note: Row "Jepthah" of Table 5 (Israel). Year-by-year table (1262-963 BC). A ruler's name is printed in one year row and his regnal-year numbers in the following rows; each row here gives the Year BC of the name row and of the last numbered row, as printed. No year is computed from a length.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 786a
reign.note: Year cell "3502 2820 307". The third printed figure 307 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 6 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxiv
